basic_details.job_title: Chandigarh Engineering Department Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh (office of the Chief Engineer) has invited applications for 1 Group-A post of Executive Engineer (Horticulture) on deputation from officers of the Central Government, State Governments, Public Sector Undertakings, Semi-Govt. and autonomous or statutory organisations. Applications in the prescribed format (Annexure-A) go by post to the Chief Engineer's office, Chandigarh-160009, and the last date for applying is 29 December 2026.

qualification.details: Officers under the Central Govt./State Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Semi-Govt./autonomous or statutory organization. Note in Annexure-I: officers under the Central/State Government holding analogous posts, or posts in the rank of Assistant Landscaping Officer/Sub Divisional Engineer (Horticulture) or equivalent, with 8 years' service in the grade and the educational qualifications and experience prescribed for direct recruitment. | M.Sc. Degree in Agriculture with specialization in Horticulture, OR M.Sc Degree in Horticulture (including Floriculture - Olericulture), OR M.Sc degree in Botany as a subject, from a recognized University or equivalent; OR B.Sc. (Agriculture) or B.Sc. (Botany) with post graduate diploma in Landscape Architecture, Horticulture from a recognized University or equivalent. Seven years' experience in Horticulture including ornamental ranging over various fields of horticulture. | Doctorate Degree in one relevant subject of a recognized University or equivalent. | The post is filled on deputation for a period of one year, which can be extended for a period of three years. Annexure-I states that the period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before the appointment in the same organization/department, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. | The crucial date for determining eligibility is counted from 15 November 2026, excluding the first date of publication in Employment News (14 November 2026). Candidates should check the Annexure-I on the official website for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

selection_process: The notice does not list selection stages. Annexure-A states that the information in the curriculum vitae
supported by documents for essential qualification and work experience
will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.
important_instructions: Applications or CVs not accompanied by supporting certificates/documents for the qualification and experience claimed will not be processed and will be rejected forthwith. Candidates who apply on deputation basis will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Vigilance clearance will not normally be granted for 3 years after the currency of a minor penalty, or 5 years after the currency of a major penalty (DOP&T OM No.11012/11/2007-Est(A) dated 14.12.2007). The borrowing department may confirm the equivalent scales of pay/posts for applicants from Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous Organizations not following Central Government scales.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Chief Engineer, Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh, from the 1st Floor, Room No.117, U.T. Secretariat, Sector-9-D, Chandigarh. The vacancy is filled under the notified recruitment rules dated 18.04.1984. Annexure-I describes the post as one in the B&R Wing of the Engineering Department.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications of eligible and willing officers who can be spared immediately are to be forwarded through proper channel in the prescribed format (Annexure-A) to this address: Chief Engineer, Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh, 1st Floor, Room No.117, U.T. Secretariat Sector-9-D, Chandigarh-160009. The form to use is the Bio-Data/Curriculum Vitae proforma (Annexure-A), printed in the notice. The detailed eligibility criteria and the list of documents to attach (Annexure-I) are on the Chandigarh Administration website, Chandigarh.gov.in/Public Notice. The notice does not specify the postal mode or what to write on the envelope. Contact details printed on the notice: telephone 0172 2740091, 2740192; fax 0172 2740276; e-mail [email protected] . The notice is signed by Mohit Singal, Executive Engineer (W&E), O/O Chief Engineer, UT, Chandigarh, mobile 9815666007.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Officers under the Central Govt./State Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Semi-Govt./autonomous or statutory organization. Note in Annexure-I: officers under the Central/State Government holding analogous posts, or posts in the rank of Assistant Landscaping Officer/Sub Divisional Engineer (Horticulture) or equivalent, with 8 years' service in the grade and the educational qualifications and experience prescribed for direct recruitment. M.Sc. Degree in Agriculture with specialization in Horticulture, OR M.Sc Degree in Horticulture (including Floriculture - Olericulture), OR M.Sc degree in Botany as a subject, from a recognized University or equivalent; OR B.Sc. (Agriculture) or B.Sc. (Botany) with post graduate diploma in Landscape Architecture, Horticulture from a recognized University or equivalent. Seven years' experience in Horticulture including ornamental ranging over various fields of horticulture. Doctorate Degree in one relevant subject of a recognized University or equivalent. The post is filled on deputation for a period of one year, which can be extended for a period of three years. Annexure-I states that the period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before the appointment in the same organization/department, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. The crucial date for determining eligibility is counted from 15 November 2026, excluding the first date of publication in Employment News (14 November 2026). Candidates should check the Annexure-I on the official website for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.pay: Rs.15600-39100+7600 GP (Pre-revised Scale); now Level-11 as per 7th CPC Rs. 67700-208700

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format (Annexure-A). Supporting certificates/documents for the qualification and experience claimed. Photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent. Certification that the particulars are correct, that no disciplinary or vigilance case is pending or contemplated, and that the officer's integrity is certified by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent. Confirmation that the officer will be relieved of his duties if selected. For officers already on deputation: forwarding by the parent cadre/department with cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate. For applicants from an organisation not following Central Government pay scales: the latest salary slip showing basic pay with scale and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances, and total emoluments. Annexure-A also asks for service details in chronological order, details of any earlier deputation, total emoluments drawn per month, additional qualifications and achievements, whether the applicant belongs to SC/ST, and the choice between deputation (ISTC), absorption or re-employment. Officers under Central/State Governments are eligible only for "absorption", and candidates of non-government organisations only for short term contract, as printed in the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice does not list selection stages. Annexure-A states that the information in the curriculum vitae, supported by documents for essential qualification and work experience, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications or CVs not accompanied by supporting certificates/documents for the qualification and experience claimed will not be processed and will be rejected forthwith. Candidates who apply on deputation basis will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Vigilance clearance will not normally be granted for 3 years after the currency of a minor penalty, or 5 years after the currency of a major penalty (DOP&T OM No.11012/11/2007-Est(A) dated 14.12.2007). The borrowing department may confirm the equivalent scales of pay/posts for applicants from Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous Organizations not following Central Government scales.

rows.details: Vacancy circular with Annexure-I and Annexure-A

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are vacant in the Chandigarh Engineering Department?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Executive Engineer (Horticulture), a Group-A post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notice gives 29 December 2026 as the last date for applying to the post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Executive Engineer (Horticulture)?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. in Agriculture with specialization in Horticulture, in Horticulture, or in Botany; OR B.Sc. (Agriculture) or B.Sc. (Botany) with a post graduate diploma in Landscape Architecture or Horticulture. Seven years' experience in Horticulture is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for this post?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.15600-39100+7600 GP (Pre-revised Scale), now Level-11 as per 7th CPC Rs. 67700-208700.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for this deputation post?
faq.answer: Officers under the Central Govt./State Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Semi-Govt./autonomous or statutory organization, whose applications are forwarded through proper channel.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-A), forwarded through proper channel, to the Chief Engineer, Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh, 1st Floor, Room No.117, U.T. Secretariat Sector-9-D, Chandigarh-160009.

faq.question: Q7. For how long is the deputation?
faq.answer: The deputation is for one year, which can be extended for a period of three years. Annexure-I says the total deputation period shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must go with the application?
faq.answer: Supporting certificates for qualification and experience, attested photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years, and the certification on vigilance, disciplinary and integrity matters.

faq.question: Q9. Can an applicant withdraw the candidature later?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates who apply on deputation basis will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.
